Summary of change: Multi-TRP enhancement Clause 7.3.1.2.1: Add a new field 'PRACH association indicator' in DCI format 1_0 to reflect agreements from RAN1#114bis and RAN1#115 meetings. Clause 7.3.1.2.2 & 7.3.1.2.3: Update the field of antenna port(s) in DCI format 1_1 and DCI format 1_2 to reflect the agreed TP from RAN1#115 meeting. [CR CR0168 for 38.212] Reason for change: Capture the agreed TPs and agreements from RAN1#114bis meeting and RAN1#115 meeting. Reflect the agreement on FDRA when ScheduledCellCombo-ListDCI-0-3 is not configured from RAN1#114bis meeting. Reflect the agreement on the minimum applicable scheduling offset indicator in DCI format 0_3/1_3 from RAN1#114bis meeting. Reflect the agreements on the SCell dormancy indication in DCI format 0_3/1_3 from RAN1#114bis meeting and RAN1#115 meeting. Reflect the agreement on TDRA from RAN1#114bis meeting. Reflect the agreement on BWP indicator from RAN1#115 meeting. Reflect the agreement on DCI size determination from RAN1#115 meeting. Summary of change: Add the clarification to FDRA field for DCI format 0_3 that all '0's for FDRA Type 2 with μ=1 or all ‘1’s for FDRA Type 2 with μ=0 indicates the corresponding cell is not scheduled. Update the description for the minimum applicable scheduling offset indicator when the bit size is equal to 1. Update the description for SCell dormancy indication in DCI format 0_3 and DCI format 1_3. Update the description for TDRA in DCI format 0_3 and DCI format 1_3 to reflect that entries of the joint table for TDRA (i.e., TDRA-FieldIndexDCI-1-3) are configured for each BWP of each CC. Update the description for BWP indicator field in DCI format 0_3/1_3. Add description on DCI size determination if an SCell within the set of cells is deactivated or dormant. Consequences if not approved: The specification for Rel-18 Multi-carrier enhancements is incomplete.

 either “enableDiffPUCCH-Resource” or “enableDiffCB-Size”, it requires same PUCCH resource in time domain or same codebook size respectively. However, the reference to determine “same time domain” or “same codebook size” is not clear in the spec. On the other hand, RAN1 clarified the supported cases for Rel-18 TEI in RAN1 #116 in following conclusion, but the case 2 in R1-2400675 is not captured explicitly in the spec. Conclusion The Case 1 and Case 2 in R1-2400675 are supported by existing TEI agreements made in RAN1#115. Case 2 in R1-2400675 is supported with UE capability FG 55-4e. Summary of change: Update RRC signalings for R18 TEI in RAN1 spec based on the latest version of TS38.331. Clarify the reference to determine “same time domain” or “same codebook size”, and add the missing Case 2 agreed in RAN1 #116. Consequences if not approved: Both gNB and UE cannot find correct RRC signalings to generate HARQ codebook corresponding to the PDSCHs scheduled after UL grant. UE does not know which PUCCH resource or codebook is used for comparing when it cannot support using a new PUCCH resource in different time domain or codebook size should be kept unchanged. On the other hand, the case 2 in R1-2400675 cannot be supported by UE.

{"chunk_id":"R1-2400039-003","collection":"ran1_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":["Spreadtrum"],"tdocNumber":"R1-2400039","title":"Remaining issues on further NR coverage enhancements"},"point_id":"2186143257415038234"}
The following text is excerpted from section 8.1 in the latest draft CR 38.213 [3]. Based on the existing specification in Section 8.1 of TS 38.213 [2], the PRACH transmission is dropped when PRACH and PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS in a same slot or the gap between PRACH and PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS is less than N. According to the discussion in the RAN1#115 meeting, this existing dropping rules should be extended to each actual PRACH transmission within multiple PRACH transmissions. However, this agreement has not captured in the latest draft CR for the legacy PRACH and PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS collision. Proposal 3: Adopt the following TP for TS 38.213 on section 8.1. Reasons for changes: Based on the existing agreement, the dropping rule of single PRACH transmission in existing spec. is extended to each actual PRACH transmission within multiple PRACH transmissions. Summary of change: Dropping rule of single PRACH is extended to multiple PRACH transmissions. Consequences if not approved: It may be not clear when applying existing dropping rule of single PRACH transmission to multiple PRACH transmissions.

the great efforts. We have the following comments: Comment#1 (TDCP) Regarding the resource setting configuration for TDCP reporting, clause 5.2.1.4.1 specifies that “The CSI Resource Setting may be periodic, with CSI-RS Resource Sets configured with higher layer parameter trs-Info”. It may cause the ambiguity that the resource setting can be aperiodic. To avoid such ambiguity,“may” should be replaced with “should”. Besides, “For a periodic CSI-ResourceConfig” is redundant and should be removed. [CR CR0005r3 for 38.215] Reason for change: Capturing the RAN1#94bis and RAN1#95 meeting agreements Summary of change: This CR combines all agreed individual draft CRs from RAN1#95 and all agreed draft Text Proposals (TP) from RAN1#94bis. The agreed TPs from RAN1#94bis make the following changes: 1. Section 5.1.3: Clarification to SS reference signal received quality (SS-RSRQ) definition for the cases with and without measurement gap configuration. Without this change, if time resources of RSSI measurement are indicated by higher-layers, measurement gap is not considered in the current definition. 2. Section 5.1.2: Clarification to CSI-RSRP measurements in case of two CSI-RS antenna ports by linear average of power contributions across CSI-RS antenna ports. Without this change it is not clear how CSI-RSRP is measured / defined for CSI-RS with two antenna ports. 3. Section 5.1.1: Remove abbreviation of “SS” from SS-RSRP definition as it is not defined in TS 38.215 and not actually needed. Editorial change to align the spec description. 4. Section 3.3: Delete “SRS” as the corresponding abbreviation is not used in TS 38.215 measurement definitions. Editorial change to align the spec description. 5. Section 5: Remove the sentence “In this chapter the physical layer measurements reported to higher layers are defined” since L1-RSRP measurement defined in TS 38.215 Section 5.1.1 is not reported to higher layers. Editorial change to align the spec description. The individual draft CRs agreed in RAN1#95 each describe the reasons and summary of the changes, these have all been incorporated as part of this Combined CR: 1. R1-1814204 [draft] CR to 38.215 on SS-RSSI definition 2. R1-1814251 [DRAFT] Correction on SS-RSRQ definition for initial cell selection Consequences if not approved: The individual draft CRs agreed in RAN1#95 each describe their consequences if not approved. In addition, the agreed TPs from RAN1#94bis present the following consequences if not approved: 1. SS-RSRQ definition is not complete, since the measurement gap is not considered in the current definition if time resources of RSSI measurement are indicated by higher-layers. 2. CSI-RSRP measurement is not clear and ambiguous when CSI-RS is configured with two antenna ports.
